title: 第3章 造化之妙第4章 婢女小瑶
slug: 伏天鼎第3279章电话沟通误会
content_zh:
四面八方的灵气，在这一瞬间全都朝着秦伏天汇聚过来……
秦伏天的身体，也如长鲸吸水一般，瞬息间便是将所有的灵气吸入体内。
这般恐怖的速度，甚至导致灵气抽刮得空气发出阵阵低沉的呜呜声！
“这吸收灵气的速度也太恐怖了！”
“这还是在低等的小世界，如果在神界，灵气更加浓郁，吸收灵气的速度还会大幅提升……”
“难怪这门法诀名为《造化吞天诀》，这简直就是要将整个天地都吞入造化神炉里！”
纵然秦伏天身为神帝，此时也是心生骇然。
在淬体境便能有这般恐怖的吸纳灵气的速度，完全超出了修炼的常理。
而接下来体内所发生的一幕，更是让秦伏天惊愕。
所有的天地灵气，并没有按照秦伏天所想，汇聚到破碎的丹田，然后在秘法加持下，一点点修复丹田。
而是，所有的灵气全都汇入到造化神炉当中。
这个吸收灵气的过程，足足持续了数个时辰。
最后！
在造化神炉当中，出现了一滴晶莹剔透的液滴。
“这是？”
秦伏天心中疑惑，数个时辰吸纳灵气，修为没有一丁点的提升，肉身也没有得到任何灵气的滋养，结果就凝聚了这么一滴液滴？
“这液滴，究竟有何奇效？”
随着秦伏天心念一动。
那一滴晶莹液滴从造化神炉之中悬浮飞出，而后瞬间融入经脉，其中蕴含的蓬勃生机随着血液的流动，流转至秦伏天周身的四肢百骸、五脏六腑……
顿时，一股舒服的感觉让秦伏天嘴里发出了轻哼之声。

就像是全身被一波波暖流淌过，接着便是传来酥酥麻麻的感觉。
几乎是不到一刻钟的时间，秦伏天体内原本还残余的伤势，便是被彻底修复。
并且……那些长年累月积累下来的暗疾，也彻底得到了改善。
而这，还仅仅只是一个开始！
神秘液滴马上开始了下一步的作用……
伴随着撕裂般的剧痛传来，秦伏天的周身所有的血脉组织，包括经脉、骨骼以及脏腑，全都被神秘液滴蛮横霸道地摧毁。
紧接着，又不断地滋生出新的组织。
就这般，摧毁，再生，摧毁，再生……
秦伏天的身体，在一遍一遍地不断蜕变！
数个时辰后，蜕变终于停了下来。
此时，窗外已是一片昏暗，夜幕降临。
秦伏天深吸一口气，此时他感觉到全身力量充盈。
“好久没有这种感觉了！”
就好像这具身体，已经干涸、荒废了几万年。
而现在，重归于掌控力量的感觉！
接着，秦伏天一拳轰出！
content_en:
Spiritual energy from all directions gathered towards Qin Futian at this moment...
Qin Futian's body was like a whale sucking water, sucking all the spiritual energy into his body in an instant.
Such a terrifying speed even caused the spiritual energy to scrape and the air to emit bursts of low whining sounds!
"The speed at which spiritual energy is absorbed is terrifying!"
"This is still in a small, low-level world. If in the God Realm, the spiritual energy is more intense, the speed of absorbing spiritual energy will be greatly increased..."
"No wonder this method is called "The Art of Devouring Heaven by Creation". It simply means swallowing the entire heaven and earth into the divine furnace of creation!"
Even though Qin Futian was the God Emperor, he was still shocked at this moment.
Being able to absorb spiritual energy at such a terrifying speed in the body tempering realm is completely beyond the common sense of cultivation.
And what happened next inside his body shocked Qin Futian even more.
All the spiritual energy of heaven and earth did not gather into the broken Dantian as Qin Futian thought, and then, with the blessing of secret techniques, repaired the Dantian bit by bit.
Instead, all the spiritual energy was merged into the Divine Furnace of Creation.
This process of absorbing spiritual energy lasted for several hours.
at last!
In the divine furnace of creation, a drop of crystal clear liquid appeared.
"This is it?"
Qin Futian was confused. After absorbing spiritual energy for several hours, his cultivation level did not improve at all, and his physical body did not receive any nourishment from spiritual energy. In the end, he condensed such a drop of liquid?
"What are the miraculous effects of this droplet?"
Following Qin Futian's thoughts.
That crystal droplet floated out from the Divine Furnace of Creation, and then instantly merged into the meridians. The vigorous vitality contained in it flowed with the flow of blood to Qin Futian's limbs, bones, internal organs...
Suddenly, a comfortable feeling made Qin Futian hum.
It was like waves of warmth were flowing through the whole body, followed by a numbing feeling.
In less than a quarter of an hour, the remaining injuries in Qin Futian's body were completely repaired.
And...those hidden diseases accumulated over many years have also been completely improved.
And this is just the beginning!
The mysterious droplet immediately began its next step...
Along with the tearing pain, all the blood tissues in Qin Futian's body, including meridians, bones and internal organs, were all destroyed arbitrarily by the mysterious droplets.
Immediately afterwards, new organizations continued to grow.
Just like that, destroy, regenerate, destroy, regenerate...
Qin Futian's body is constantly transforming over and over again!
After several hours, the transformation finally stopped.
At this time, it was dark outside the window, and night was falling.
Qin Futian took a deep breath, and at this moment he felt that his whole body was full of strength.
"I haven't felt this way for a long time!"
It was as if this body had dried up and been abandoned for tens of thousands of years.
And now, the feeling of being in control is back!
Then, Qin Futian punched out!
